old_caption: The video captures a serene landscape scene at sunset. The sky is painted with hues of orange, pink, and blue, transitioning into darker shades as it meets the horizon. Clouds are scattered across the sky, adding depth to the scene. Below, a calm body of water reflects the vibrant colors of the sky and the silhouettes of the trees on its far bank. The trees, mostly coniferous, stand tall and dark against the colorful backdrop, their reflections shimmering on the water's surface. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, allowing viewers to take in the tranquil beauty of the scene. There are no visible animals or characters in the video, emphasizing the peaceful solitude of nature. The overall atmosphere is one of quiet contemplation, inviting viewers to appreciate the natural world.

caption: The video captures a wide, fixed landscape of a calm, partially frozen lake under a layered blue-grey sky with an orange horizon band. On the right, dark leafless trees, including one tall conifer, stand fronted by pale pinkish dry reeds. The lower half mirrors the sky, the orange glow, and the inverted trees. This mirror image is not static: the reflected tree shapes and cloud and orange bands shift, stretch, and break slightly with gentle ripples. The reflected conifer tip and the vertical streaks of the tree reflection change form and length, while the real trees stay fixed. No person, animal, or vehicle enters, and the shoreline and horizon hold their positions. Faint differences in the overhead clouds stay within slow drift, so the clearest movement is the water's. This rippling of the reflection is already underway on the first frame and continues to the last without onset or completion.

not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
